cover.report_type: Year-End Report: January 31 of each year

_meta.notes: LABEL DISAGREEMENT: the clerk listing calls this '2006 Summary Report/Dissolution', but the form checks ONLY the YEAR-END REPORT (January 31) box - the Final Report box is NOT checked and there is no dissolution notice in the 4-page document. Written in heavy marker; re-rendered page 2 at 250 dpi. Column A reconciles exactly (10,968.24 + 7,826.22 = 18,794.46; minus 15,752.68 = 3,041.78) and Line 3 matches Line 7 of this candidate's October 31 report. The Column B figures are recorded at medium confidence - the last digit of 49,159.04 runs past the cell edge - and note that 49,159.04 - 46,117.71 = 3,041.33, 45 cents off the Line 7 balance; kept verbatim, no correction made.

contributions.detail: exact (7,826.22 = 7,826.22); 11 typed rows plus the 2 handwritten rows added below them sum to the handwritten Total 7,826.22 on the attachment, which equals Summary Page line 1 Column A. The two handwritten additions are REQUIRED for it to close

expenditures.detail: exact (15,752.68 = 15,752.68); 5 typed rows plus the 1 handwritten row sum to the handwritten Total 15,752.68

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: Neither attachment prints a 'SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE' - they are the filer's own one-page lists, each ending in a handwritten 'Total'. Gate applied at that Total and both close to the cent: contributions rows 7,826.22 = written Total 7,826.22; expenditures rows 15,752.68 = written Total 15,752.68. The gates are load-bearing here because they prove the handwritten rows appended under each typed list ARE part of the schedule, not marginalia.
itemized.escalation_note: p3 is a LANDSCAPE attachment: re-rendered at 300 dpi, rotated +90 (counter-clockwise) and tight-cropped to the row block, which is where the typed values and the two handwritten additions were read (hence verified=1 on the contribution rows). The p4 expenditure list is portrait and needed no escalation.
itemized.notes: 4-page filing (Leslie Reberg, Recorder, year-end 1-31-07). p1 cover, p2 Summary Page, p3 a LANDSCAPE typed 'Revenues' list, p4 a portrait typed 'Expenditures' list. The county's own Schedule A/B forms are NOT used - the filer substituted their own two lists, so there are no SUBTOTAL cells and no address column anywhere; donor city/state therefore do not exist in this document and none was invented. BOTH lists were AMENDED BY HAND after printing: two extra contribution rows (UPEA 500 IN KIND on 11/17/06, CWA Cope PAC 200 on 11/08/06) and one extra expenditure row (Target Group, 500 IN KIND, consulting fees) are written below the typed text, and each list's Total is handwritten. The handwritten rows are genuine schedule lines - both totals only close with them included. The expenditure list also carries two STRIKE-OUTS: a struck word (reads like 'loan') after the tyson organization amount, and a fully struck-out recipient name on the handwritten Target Group line; neither struck text was guessed. Three amounts carry a trailing word rather than cents ('300 CASH', '3926.22 LOAN', '500 IN KIND') - the word is recorded in the row note and only the figure in the amount field.
